title: And do you know why?
html_source:
When Deasy reveals the why, we are left in no doubt that he is anti-semite. Joyce reveals the nature of his characters through dialogue and internal monolgoue far more than his contemporaries who, though clearly modernists just tell us about their characters:

“It’s due west', said the atheist Tansley”, To the Lighthouse, Virginia Woolf or Lord help us do so through plain ole prose “Walking along a narrow muddy causeway by a little river overhung with willows, girls ahead of her in single file and girls in single file behind, Miriam drearily recognised it was June. The month of roses, she thought,and looked out across the flat green fields”, Pilgrimmage 1, Dorothy Richardson.
